details:
It seems too hard to actually get vote kicks across in lobbies. It seems like you need too many people to actually be able to kick someone. Plus, if someone is disturbing a group of people in one side of the map, the on the other side of the map will most likely not be sure if they should kick the chosen player therefore not ever getting them kicked. I've been in multiple world instances were multiple votes have to start in order to finally get someone to be kicked, even though a ton of people in the lobby are being annoyed by the particular person.
Solution: Decrease the number of people required to kick a player, it shouldn't be a simple majority, it should be something around 1/3 of the player count on the server, excluding the voted player and the initiator. So for example, if you have a world with exactly 20 people and someone gets voted, you have 18 players who are capable of voting. Then out of those players, you would only need 6 of them to vote a player out. (Which is still a big number) There should be a minimum amount of players for smaller worlds, maybe having the cap be at 4-5 people (so in a world of 7 people, you would need 100% of the other players to vote out the player).
title: Make it easier to kick people with the vote to kick system
